caseStudy.assurance: Price Waterhouse & Co Chartered Accountants LLP provided reasonable assurance over specified standalone BRSR Core indicators; see the report for the exact assured scope.

ratioEquivalentInputs.div_wage_f/div_wage_t: 7/100 reproduces the reported 7% female wage share; underlying rupee amounts were not disclosed.
ratioEquivalentInputs.inc_msme/inc_totalpur: 11/100 reproduces the reported 11% MSME sourcing share; underlying rupee amounts were not disclosed.
ratioEquivalentInputs.inc_town_wages/inc_total_wages: 19.34/100 reproduces rural plus semi-urban wage share of 0.03% + 19.31%; underlying rupee amounts were not disclosed.
ratioEquivalentInputs.fair_ap/fair_cogs: 94/365 reproduces 94 days because the report discloses the result but not both monetary components.
ratioEquivalentInputs.open_top10/open_totalsales: 29/100 reproduces the reported top-ten dealer concentration; underlying sales amounts were not disclosed.
ratioEquivalentInputs.open_rp/open_totcat: 39/100 reproduces the reported related-party purchase share; the report separately gives sales, loans and advances, and investment shares.

unavailableInputs.g_hours/saf_lti: The report gives employee and worker LTIFR but not the matching lost-time injury counts and hours needed by this calculator.
unavailableInputs.fair_cust_breach/fair_tot_breach: Both counts are nil, so a percentage has no positive denominator and remains unavailable.
